# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `createos` MCP server pointing at CreateOS's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api-createos.nodeops.network/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and CreateOS sign-in — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: CreateOS's official app icon from createos.sh.
